headline: Google makes Gemini 4 Argon globally available and reports agentic-work results
summary: On Oct. 13, Google said Gemini 4 Argon was globally available through the Gemini API and selected Google products, following a phased trusted-tester release announced Sept. 30. Google lists a 1M-token output limit and introductory API pricing of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens through Nov. 30, 2026; listed prices then rise to $4 and $20. Google reports internal gains including 35% more agentic code submissions with nearly one-third fewer rollbacks, faster Agent Development Kit operations, xTB molecular-modeling speedups and a Gemma inference optimization. These deployment and performance results are first-party claims; the public code links make some implementation changes inspectable, but this review did not independently reproduce them or evaluate Argon against matched external baselines.
